# UALR Public Radio

> > UALR Public Radio provides in-depth news coverage and analysis on technology, international conflicts, social justice, and public policy.

UALR Public Radio delivers NPR programming and original reporting, featuring interviews with experts, policymakers, and thought leaders on critical issues including AI technology developments, the Ukraine crisis, racial justice, and Middle East policy. The station serves as a vital source for comprehensive news analysis and community-focused journalism.

## Key Topics

- NPR
- Ukraine conflict
- AI and ChatGPT
- Racial trauma and police reform
- Middle East policy
- Technology breakthroughs
- National security
- Community healing
- Cal Newport
- OpenAI
- Biden administration policy
- International crisis reporting
- Social justice
- Scientific innovation

## International Conflicts & Security

- [Ukrainians brace for 'likely' Russian invasion](https://www.ualrpublicradio.org/2022-01-31/ukrainians-brace-for-likely-russian-invasion): Mary Louise Kelly reports from Kyiv on Russian invasion threat
- [In Ukraine, crop fields riddled with landmines put farmers' lives at risk](https://www.ualrpublicradio.org/2023-04-13/in-ukraine-crop-fields-riddled-with-landmines-put-farmers-lives-at-risk): HALO Trust's Major General Cowan on Ukraine landmine crisis for farmers
- [National Security Council's John Kirby on Biden administration's response to Israeli strikes on Gaza](https://www.ualrpublicradio.org/2023-11-02/national-security-councils-john-kirby-on-biden-administrations-response-to-israeli-strikes-on-gaza): John Kirby discusses Biden administration's Gaza-Israel policy response

## Technology & AI Analysis

- [Bubbling questions about the limitations of AI](https://www.ualrpublicradio.org/2025-08-23/bubbling-questions-about-the-limitations-of-ai): NPR's Scott Detrow interviews Cal Newport on AI limitations & progress
- [A few of the promising scientific and technological breakthroughs of 2022](https://www.ualrpublicradio.org/2022-12-26/a-few-of-the-promising-scientific-and-technological-breakthroughs-of-2022): Derek Thompson reviews 2022's AI & cancer treatment breakthroughs

## Social Justice & Community Issues

- [Racial trauma therapist reflects on damage and pain after Tyre Nichols' killing](https://www.ualrpublicradio.org/2023-01-30/racial-trauma-therapist-reflects-on-damage-and-pain-after-tyre-nichols-killing): Resmaa Menakem discusses racial trauma after Tyre Nichols killing
